events.title: DeepSeek partners with Huawei to develop chip programming tools, reducing reliance on Nvidia
events.retenir: DeepSeek et Huawei unissent leurs forces pour créer des outils de programmation alternatifs à ceux de Nvidia.
events.title_fr: DeepSeek partners with Huawei to develop chip programming tools, reducing reliance on Nvidia

events.title: DeepSeek invests $2.56 billion in Huawei Ascend 950DT for data center, faces challenges in transitioning from CUDA
events.retenir: DeepSeek investit 2,56 milliards de dollars dans les puces Huawei Ascend tout en collaborant sur des outils logiciels pour concurrencer CUDA.
events.title_fr: DeepSeek invests $2.56 billion in Huawei Ascend 950DT for data center, faces challenges in transitioning from CUDA

events.title: DeepSeek Targets Nvidia's Software Moat With Huawei Partnership
events.retenir: Le partenariat entre DeepSeek et Huawei vise directement la domination logicielle de Nvidia sur les puces.
events.title_fr: DeepSeek Targets Nvidia's Software Moat With Huawei Partnership

events.title: AMD makes a big bet on the next era of AI with World Labs acquisition
events.retenir: AMD rachète World Labs pour 8,2 milliards de dollars et intègre la pionnière de l'IA Fei-Fei Li.
events.title_fr: AMD makes a big bet on the next era of AI with World Labs acquisition

events.title: Nvidia Up on Share-Repurchase Program; Mining Stocks Slide | Stock Movers
events.retenir: Nvidia monte en Bourse après l'extension de son programme de rachat, alors que les minières comme Northern Star reculent.
events.title_fr: Nvidia Up on Share-Repurchase Program; Mining Stocks Slide
